regions.quote: P. malayana is found living syntopically with P. semicincta across much of its range and in the Endau river drainage, southeastern Peninsular Malaysia sympatric fishes include Brevibora dorsiocellata, Rasbora cephalotaenia, R. einthovenii, R. dusonensis, R. paucisqualis, 'Puntius' johorensis, 'P.' partipentazona, Trigonopoma gracile, T. pauciperforatum, Betta pugnax, Sphaerichthys osphromenoides, Acanthopsoides molobrion, Vaillantella maassi, Pangio cuneovirgata, P. doriae, P. filinaris, P. piperata and P. shelfordii.
